subject: science
passage: Periodical cicadas in eastern North America spend thirteen or seventeen years underground, then emerge at the same time in enormous numbers, sometimes more than a million per acre. Birds, squirrels, and other animals feast on them, yet most of the insects survive long enough to mate and lay eggs. One explanation is that the predators are simply ______: they eat until they can eat no more, and the vast majority of cicadas are left untouched.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: Predators "feast" and "eat until they can eat no more," yet most cicadas survive. The cicadas escape not because predators avoid them but because there are far too many for the predators to eat. Being faced with more than one can handle is being overwhelmed, so "overwhelmed" fits.
explanation.A: Correct. With more than a million cicadas per acre, predators fill up long before they can eat most of them; they are overwhelmed by the sheer numbers.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Deterred" would mean the predators are discouraged from eating cicadas, but the text says they "feast" on them.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The predators "eat until they can eat no more," so they are full, the opposite of starved.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Nothing in the text suggests the cicadas trick predators; they survive because there are too many to eat.
